title: Quaint Malty Egyptian Chickpeas Wrap
description: A malty, chewy, nostalgic Egyptian dish featuring chickpeas, this wrap is perfect for a snack or light meal, and is anti-inflammatory friendly due to the turmeric and ginger used in the recipe.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the malt syrup, turmeric, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chickpeas to the skillet and stir to combine with the malt syrup mixture.
Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chickpeas are coated in the malt syrup mixture.
Warm the whole wheat tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the chickpea mixture onto a tortilla and serving immediately.
